title: 2.5 Hour Private Sightseeing Tour of Hollywood and Beverly Hills
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Pickup and drop-off from designated meeting points
Hotel pickup and drop-off (selected hotels only)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Collapsible wheelchairs with removable wheels can be accommodated providing the passenger is accompanied by someone who can assist them board and disembark

A reminder that this is not a group tour. Every tour we do is private, so it's just you and your immediate party. Tours are conducted in luxury discreet black SUV's, and guests are welcome to customize their excursion by their timeframe and interests. Our tours come highly recommended by the 5-star Beverly Hills and Los Angeles area hotel concierge desks, as well as countless domestic and international travel agents and travel sites.
We use the tier pricing format here on TripAdvisor Experiences. When entering the number of guests for your private tour, the amount will be the equivalent of our regular posted rates.
Only service animals as defined by the ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) and California state law allowed. Emotional support dogs or other animals prohibited.

In the tour details listed above, there are few options that best describe timeframes for stops and drive-by introductions. Plus, there are a handful of locations not listed in available "Attractions." Some attractions may not be accessible on certain days of the year. This tour is a solid 2 hours, and we've laid out a guesstimate on stops and travel time. Remember, this is a private tour, so you're also welcome to fully customize your time.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our most sought-after quick excursion! If you are pressed for time and seek a comprehensive overview of the Hollywood, West Hollywood, and Beverly Hills areas, this 2.5-hour private tour is ideal for you and your immediate group. You will travel in a black SUV accompanied by a knowledgeable and personable guide who is dedicated to showcasing the city’s highlights. Discover why this tour is highly recommended by the luxury community, including five-star local hotel concierges, as well as international and domestic travel agents.
